title: James F NDE 118
content: Shortly after eating a large dinner three days before Thanksgiving Day, 1996, I had experienced pains to my chest that was so sharp that it dropped me to my knees. After a few minutes, I felt better but had a numbing sensation in my left arm that would not go away. I just discounted the pain as just indigestion. However, the numbing sensation persisted the next day, causing me a great deal of concern. To make a long story short, I was taken to the hospital and I underwent a catheterization procedure the day after Thanksgiving. All was going fine, in fact, the doctor had nearly finished one half of the procedure when all of the sudden everything went gray. I began to experience the most wonderful sensation that I had ever felt. I was floating through what seemed to be a red tunnel of some sort. At the end of the tunnel was a bright light that did not bother my eyes at all. The light gave me a sense of strength and joy that is indescribable. Once I arrived at the end of the tunnel, I saw a black table and seven people all dressed in white clothing standing on the other side of the table. Six to my right and one to my left. I did not recognize any of the people standing before me. However, I do remember the table. The table top was made of gold and the table legs were thin, tall and square. On top of the table was a book in front of the person that was directly to my left. I remember wanting to go further towards the light. I had no other thoughts other than wanting to go on towards the light. I know one or two of the people behind the table had said something to me but I cannot remember what. But then, almost as quickly as everything had gone to gray I was brought back. The doctor had brought my heart back to normal by using defibrillator paddles on me. If it had not been for that, I am sure that I would have been in the hands of God that day. My father had always told me that when it is your time that there would be nothing that I could do about it. It was not my time to go and I am not afraid now if today were the day.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: No cardiac catheterization procedure Life threatening event, but not clinical death Heart fibrillation
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Light | Strong emotional tone
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I do not remember seeing any physical part of my body during the experience. I did not notice my arms or my nose before my face.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I know one or two of the people (women) behind the table said something to me but cannot recall what.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes Bright, gave me a sense of wellbeing, warmth, did not bother my eyes
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm See text above.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes My wife claims that I have calmed down about many things that used to bother me before the experience.
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes My wife claims that I have calmed down about many things that used to bother me before the experience. After the NDE
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The bright light and coming back.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Pastor of church I was attending, fellowship group at church, family, co-workers.
